title: Subscription Traps: New Consumer Rules!

scenes.text: New rules could end the sneaky subscription traps plaguing consumers!
Consumers faced hidden fees and complicated cancellations, frustrating many.
Mayor Mamdani's new rules aim to bring clarity and fairness.
Great news for consumers! Say goodbye to unexpected junk fees!
